items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: Well I think King Collier to me, not because I made the record with him

ctx.x: Well I was thinking about King Collier and different guys like that.

Well I think King Collier to me, not because I made the record with him, but I think he played more near to the old Dixieland and these guys that he was playing with. What I can recall, to one of the numbers that this Englishman played, one of the rags that they tried to play and I couldn't catch because when they called me when they was playing over the air they played some of their numbers to let the people know what they had. And one of the numbers that we played, and they started off and when they got to the…
Which band was this? Is this Chris Ballmer or which one do you remember?
